title: Epsilon-Nets of Antigenic Space: Conditional Bounds for Broad-Spectrum Antibody Cocktails

creators.name: Devanik Debnath
creators.affiliation: National Institute of Technology Agartala (author-provided affiliation; not an institutional endorsement)

description: Independent theoretical preprint: conditional range-space formulation for passive antibody cocktail coverage using classical VC epsilon-net theory, o-minimal/Pfaffian definability, published epsilon-k-net theory, a weighted small-atom sufficient lemma, robust antigenic neighborhoods, and synthetic verification. No empirical neutralization or antivenom data were analyzed; no universal protection or clinical efficacy is claimed.
notes: Metadata prepared for possible future deposition only. No Zenodo deposit was made and no DOI was minted or claimed.
